verdict.rationale: Canva's official MCP server lets AI assistants work with Canva designs. Its documentation explicitly lists design export in multiple production formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4) and resizing for different channels, which gives an agent a documented programmatic export surface. The evidence for export itself is a single summary bullet, without tool-level parameters or limits like those shown for resize-design. missing for 10: tool-level documentation of the export tool (parameters, rate limits, plan gating), explicit screenshot/thumbnail rendering, an explicit REST export endpoint in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface

citations.quote: Design export:** Generate exports in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4, and so on) and resize designs for different channels
The Canva MCP server enables AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Canva's design capabilities.
Automatically create resized versions of designs in new dimensions, formats, or aspect ratios.
